# Small Study
Composer: A. Composer. File: small.musicxml.
Bars 0–4 (5 bars; bar 0 is a pickup). Key: G major or E minor (1 fifths). Metre: 4 quarter-note beats a bar. Tempo: not marked.

## The score
"m<number>" starts a bar; its line also shows a key change (key=<fifths>), a new bar length (len=<beats>), a clef change (clef R=g L=f), and the score's words, dynamics and pedal marks (ped / *). Then one line per hand: "R:" the upper staff, "L:" the lower. Each event is onset:pitch/duration in quarter-note beats from the start of the bar; "+" joins notes struck together (a chord whose notes last equally shows one duration at the end, C4+E4+G4/2; otherwise each note shows its own); "t" marks a tuplet note; "~" a note tied over the bar line (it sounds on into the next bar without being struck again); "gr(C5,D5)" grace notes before a note; "tr" a trill, turn or mordent. A bar split in two by a repeat prints as m12 and m12'.

R: 0:D5/1
L: -

R: 0:G4/1 1:A4/1 2:B4/1 3:C5/1
L: 0:G3/8~
m2
R: 0:gr(C#5)D5/0.333t 0.333:E5/0.333t 0.667:F#5/0.333t 1:G5/1tr
